key.name: background-enabled
key.description: Quit pauses the panel, global shortcut, and automatic switching. Opening KeyFlip resumes them.

key.name: toggle-mode-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcuts that switch between Laptop Mode and Desk Mode while the GNOME extension is enabled. An empty list disables the shortcut.

key.name: automatic-mode-switching
key.description: Activate Desk Mode when an external keyboard connects and restore Laptop Mode when it disconnects.

key.name: automatic-disable-owned
key.description: Records whether KeyFlip automatically disabled the internal keyboard so it can safely restore it later.
